payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the SATA-LSTM model against various baseline models, including both syntactic and non-syntactic approaches.

claims.text: The SATA-LSTM model was compared against neural models built on syntactic trees, latent trees, and non-tree models.
The SATA Tree-LSTM outperformed previous syntactic tree-based models and other neural models, achieving state-of-the-art results on several tasks.
The model's performance was also compared to existing state-of-the-art results from structurally pre-trained models like ELMo.
